description: Implementation of service for managing interest pause variations on loans, including creation, update, and deletion within the Fineract microfinance platform.

classes.name: InterestPauseWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing interest pause variations on loans, including creation, update, and deletion.

methods.name: createInterestPause
methods.description: Creates a new interest pause variation on a loan given by external ID or numerical ID, with specified start and end dates.

methods.name: deleteInterestPause
methods.description: Deletes an existing interest pause variation identified by variation ID, for a specified loan.

methods.name: updateInterestPause
methods.description: Updates the start and end dates of an existing interest pause variation identified by variation ID.

methods.name: processDeleteInterestPause
methods.description: Internal method to handle deletion of an interest pause variation.

methods.name: processUpdateInterestPause
methods.description: Internal method to handle updating an interest pause variation.

methods.name: processInterestPause
methods.description: Validates and creates a new interest pause variation for a loan.

methods.name: validateInterestPauseDates
methods.description: Validates that the interest pause dates are within the loan's start and maturity dates, do not overlap with existing pauses, and conform to loan conditions.

methods.name: validateActiveLoan
methods.description: Checks if the loan status is ACTIVE before performing operations.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into a LocalDate object according to the provided format and locale.
